sections.text:
Release & Protection for 
Hydraulic HP- bypass & Injection valve

items: Clean filter oil for servo valve.
Check hydraulic pump pressure and insure no leakage.
Check coil for emergency solenoid valve (measure resistance, check socket).
Adjust stroke for valve and check potion mA
Check wiring up to junction box to DCS, to solenoids, from pressure switches.
Check signal up to ovation screen and output command from ovation controller.
Check faults and fault lamps.
Check ( pressure transmitter, temperature element ) for control loop.
Check normal operation during start up and return if required.

sections.text:
Release & 
Protection for Electrical HP- bypass & Injection Valve

items: Check limit switch (measure resistance) .
Check socket (clean socket, check wiring terminal).
Check power unit (contactor, relay, operation).
Check positioner ( measure power supply, check {mA circuit ).
Adjust stroke.
Check wiring up to junction box.
Check signal up to ovation screen and output command from ovation controller.

Check ( pressure transmitter, flow transmitter, temperature element ) for 
 control loop.
Check normal operation during start up and return if required.

Adjust stroke
Check signal up to ovation screen and output command from ovation controller.

Procedure:

Introduction
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The Control & 
 Protection of HP bypass & Live steam consists of:
Release and Protection testing for HP bypass & Live steam system:
a- HP-bypass (Hydraulic) .
b- HP-bypass (Electrical) .
c- Live steam & Warm up valve for live steam.
For testing protection system perform the following:
Each protection loop have (sensor, switch, software logic, I/O electronic 
 modules, and final control element test)
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. 
 Ashraf Ahmed, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Fekry Yousef, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 Al-Emam, accepted by eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed: general manager, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.

 certified by eng. Mervat Ez-Elden: EDEPC head sector of inspection & 
 quality control's sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified
 and carry the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The Turbine & the boiler must be shutdown

and Equipment
Digital multi-meter, Fluke 178
Screw driver kit, manual tools .
Oil spray cleaner & Teflon roll .
Current injector .
Spanner .
